summary: Wallbox N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q1 2026 earnings press release and presentation. The filing reports revenue of €29.7 million, gross margin of 37.3%, operating loss of €11.7 million, and an improvement in adjusted EBITDA to €(6.0) million. It also notes secured €11 million in interim financing and a signed comprehensive restructuring plan aimed at long-term financial visibility. This is a routine earnings announcement with no transaction, shareholder vote, or special-situation catalyst, so no special-situation classification applies.
